title: Exact-once checksum-bound Spec 014 Wave 1 Apply contract

phases.objective: Provide a separately authorized exact-once Wave 1 Apply contract that requires pre-existing Runtime Readiness authorization, exact Production parity, ledger-first duplicate prevention, a same-cycle zero-risk dry-run, one non-retriable Apply attempt, and exact ledger/table certification.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authorized repository operator reviewing the Spec 014 Wave 1 Apply boundary
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Static Apply workflow, executor, and exact-trigger contract
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The repository exposes one exact issue-comment-gated Apply path that fails closed unless Runtime Readiness authorization already exists, revalidates the reviewed migration and exact Production runtime, performs readback and a same-cycle dry-run before one Apply request, never retries ambiguous execution, and requires exact ledger and four-table certification afterward.
steps: Require the exact Apply comment on issue #6215 from an OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR.
Reject push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch, and automatic Apply triggers.
Checkout trusted main and verify it contains repository readiness and the merged Runtime Readiness contract.
Verify protected Production contains the exact reviewed Wave 1 migration blob and the runtime reports that same stable Production SHA.
Perform governed migration ledger/schema readback before creating an execution envelope or sending Apply.
Use the supported read-only /admin/control DB contract with action=run and the fixed statement in the sql field when reading the exact authorization row.
If the exact Apply ledger and four expected tables already exist, report already_applied and send no Apply.
Otherwise read the exact governed migration authorization row created by Runtime Readiness and prove checksum, statement count, source PR, source merge, zero-risk preflight, and allow_apply=1.
Never create or rotate readiness authorization from the Apply contract.
Repeat the zero-risk governed dry-run in the same workflow execution.
Create and apply-authorize one Production- and checksum-bound governed_migration_execute envelope with external writes disabled.
Send exactly one Apply request using the filename-derived confirmation and never retry an unsuccessful or ambiguous response.
Require exact Apply ledger and the four foundation tables after execution.
Upload sanitized evidence without GitHub writes, provider calls, deployments, restarts, or protected-ref mutations.
assertions: The workflow trigger is exactly APPLY_20260802_01_SPEC014_HOSTINGER_STORAGE_FOUNDATION on issue #6215 and differs from the Runtime Readiness trigger.
The workflow has contents:read only and no push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch, Issue write, PR write, or repository mutation permission.

The executor pins Wave 1 blob 1e820553d95e5bdb5f8c49d7bf09cb159c51c7bc, checksum 9eca6e585d12de633931c7d7e099f467a955aaf7b819ccb2660d34acf63d5053, four statements, source PR #4564, and source merge 7a96920eff2579321707d193a1d030e6454891b1.
The authorization-row readback uses DB action=run with the fixed SQL in the sql field, remains read_only with bounded max_rows, and never uses unsupported action=query.

The Apply contract never creates readiness authorization; it requires exactly one authorized governed_migration_authorization_registry row with matching policy, source, checksum, statement count, source PR, source merge, zero-risk preflight, and allow_apply=1.
Readback-first prevents duplicate Apply when the exact ledger and four tables already exist.
The same-cycle dry-run reports mode=dry_run, applies_sql=false, exact checksum and statement count, preflight pass, and zero risks.
The execution envelope requires explicit apply authorization under governed_migration_execute_apply_v1 and external_write_allowed=false.
The executor contains exactly one mode=apply request and never retries Apply after an unsuccessful or ambiguous response.
An ambiguous Apply response records apply_sent=true, retry_permitted=false, and requires exact readback before any future operator decision.
Success requires exact Apply ledger metadata and all four foundation tables.
No provider call, credential payload read, external business write, deployment, restart, Production ref mutation, or secret evidence occurs during contract validation.

phases.objective: After merge and explicit exact Apply confirmation, execute one Apply attempt and retain exact authorization, dry-run, ledger, and four-table Artifacts.

Prove ambiguous-response handling, duplicate-ledger reuse, stale authorization rejection, checksum drift rejection, Production drift rejection, and no-retry behavior against controlled non-production fixtures.
Verify the four foundation tables through bounded non-production storage canaries after the exact migration ledger is present.
Complete the final #6215 audit and authorize later Wave 2 only after Wave 1 ledger and schema readback remain exact.
